lines.beaver: 겨울옷 정리하자. 이 셔츠는 왜 이렇게 구겨졌니?
lines.beaver_en: Let's sort the winter clothes. Why is this shirt so wrinkled?
lines.beaver_roman: gyeouron jeongnihaja. i syeocheuneun wae ireoke gugyeojyeonni?
lines.en: It got wrinkled when I folded it. I hope we can iron it.

lines.beaver_en: How should we wash it? Put it in the washer?
lines.learner: 이 옷감은 약해서 손으로 빨았으면 해요.
lines.en: This fabric is delicate, so I hope we hand-wash it.
lines.roman: i otgameun yakaeseo soneuro ppallasseumyeon haeyo.

lines.beaver: 이 바지는 어때? 이건 헐렁해 보이는데.
lines.beaver_en: What about these pants? They look loose.
lines.beaver_roman: i bajineun eottae? igeon heolleonghae boineunde.
lines.en: Yes, they're too loose. I'd like them taken in.

lines.beaver: 내복은 어디에 둘까? 날씨가 부쩍 추워졌잖아.
lines.beaver_en: Where should the long underwear go? It's gotten much colder.
lines.beaver_roman: naebogeun eodie dulkka? nalssiga bujjeok chuwojyeotjana.
lines.learner: 내복은 잘 보이는 서랍에 넣었으면 해요.
lines.en: I'd like the long underwear in an easy-to-see drawer.
lines.roman: naebogeun jal boineun seorabe neoeosseumyeon haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Lots of sneakers too. Do you wear them all?
lines.en: I'd like to keep just two pairs of sneakers.

lines.beaver_en: What about the slippers? They're a bit worn.
lines.learner: 실내화는 새로 샀으면 해요. 착용감이 좋은 걸로요.
lines.en: I hope we buy new slippers. Comfortable ones.
lines.roman: sillaehwaneun saero sasseumyeon haeyo. chagyonggami joeun geolloyo.

lines.beaver: 너는 요즘 어떤 옷을 입고 싶어?
lines.beaver_en: What kind of clothes do you want to wear these days?
lines.beaver_roman: neoneun yojeum eotteon oseul ipgo sipeo?
lines.learner: 어제 패션쇼를 봤는데 저도 멋지게 입었으면 해요.
lines.en: I saw a fashion show yesterday. I hope I can dress nicely too.
lines.roman: eoje paesyeonsyoreul bwanneunde jeodo meotjige ibeosseumyeon haeyo.

lines.beaver: 그래? 그럼 이 코트는 어때? 매서운 바람도 막아 줘.
lines.beaver_en: Really? How about this coat? It blocks the bitter wind.
lines.beaver_roman: geurae? geureom i koteuneun eottae? maeseoun baramdo maga jwo.
lines.learner: 옷감이 따뜻해서 좋아요. 겨울에 입었으면 해요.
lines.en: The fabric is warm, I like it. I'd like to wear it this winter.
lines.roman: otgami ttatteutaeseo joayo. gyeoure ibeosseumyeon haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. The closet feels roomier now that it's tidy.
lines.en: From now on, I hope my clothes don't get wrinkled.

lines.beaver: 그럼 옷걸이에 잘 걸어 두자. 수고했어.
lines.beaver_en: Then let's hang them on hangers. Good work.
lines.beaver_roman: geureom otgeorie jal georeo duja. sugohaesseo.
lines.learner: 엄마도 수고하셨어요. 다음에도 같이 정리했으면 해요.
lines.en: You too, Mom. I hope we tidy up together again.
lines.roman: eommado sugohasyeosseoyo. daeumedo gachi jeongnihaesseumyeon haeyo.
